AnatomicSegmentMention.description:
GI segments relevant to IBD endoscopic assessment.
Includes upper GI (CD), lower GI (CD + UC), and post-surgical anatomy.

Use the most specific segment stated in the note.

If a finding is described but the segment is not stated, use UNSPECIFIED.

Do not infer a segment from disease subtype or typical IBD distribution.

Endoscopic procedure documented in the note.

Capture the procedure type and exam-level features such as the most proximal
segment reached, skip lesions, rectal involvement, upper GI involvement, and
ileal involvement.

PhysicianGlobalAssessmentMention.description:
Physician overall qualitative assessment of endoscopic disease severity.

Capture only an explicitly stated overall impression, such as normal,
minimal, mild, moderate, or severe disease/activity.

Do not calculate severity from individual findings such as erythema, friability, erosions, or ulcers.

physician_global_assessment.description: Explicit overall endoscopic severity impression. NONE: normal, remission, or no active inflammatory disease; MINIMAL: minimal disease/activity; MILD: mild disease/activity; MODERATE: moderate disease/activity; SEVERE: severe disease/activity; NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: no explicit overall severity impression is documented.

description:
Document-level extraction of endoscopic findings from a single endoscopy report or endoscopy-related note section.

Variables:
* procedure: Procedure type, exam extent, and exam-level involvement flags.
* continuous: Whether inflammatory involvement is described as continuous or discontinuous/patchy/skip.
* segment_findings:  Per-segment endoscopic findings such as mucosal appearance, ulceration, stenosis, or fistula orifice.
* physician_global_assessment: Physician's explicit overall impression of endoscopic disease severity.
title: IbdEndoscopyAnnotation
